title: Minimum in a rotated sorted array
summary: Return the smallest element of `nums`, a sorted array that has been rotated.
hints: Compare the middle element with the last element. What does each possible outcome tell you about which side the smallest element is on?
If the middle element is greater than the last, the drop to the minimum is somewhere to its right. Otherwise the minimum is the middle element or something to its left.
Binary search with low and high: if nums[mid] > nums[high], set low = mid + 1; otherwise set high = mid. Stop when low equals high; that position holds the minimum.
takeaway: Binary search works whenever one comparison lets you discard half the range; the data does not need to be fully sorted. O(log n). Note `high = mid`, not `mid - 1`: the middle element may itself be the answer.
